create_uint4x2_mixed_mm_template: create a TritonTemplate for uint4x2 mixed matrix multiplication with configurable grid and kernel source
run_tuned_uint4x2_mixed_mm: run tuned_uint4x2_mixed_mm to autotune and select the best kernel configuration for two input matrices
build_mm_args: build mm_args to extract matrix dimensions, layout, and pointers from two input tensors
build_mm_configs: build mm_configs to generate a list of block size configurations for given matrix dimensions
build_mm_options: build mm_options to produce kernel configuration options from a block size config and matrix parameters
